name: print-social-purple-gradient-events-agency-curved-photo-panels
title: Purple Events Post with Curved Photo Panels
whatItIs: A square purple gradient post with a logo top left, a headline 'We make every Events like:', a curved rainbow-dotted arc and three curved photo panels of outdoor, corporate and internal events with captions below each and thin leader lines.
whatItMeans: Curved photo windows on flowing purple lines feel dynamic and celebratory, fitting an events brand.
techniques: Photos cropped into curved pillow shapes
Thin leader lines linking photos to captions
Dotted coloured arc as a decorative smile
Contour lines flowing across the gradient
Large light headline with one giant word
bestFor: Social posts with a photo trio

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked into a soft curved shape.
A thin line linking an image to its caption.
Flowing thin lines used as a background texture.
